name: interface_test
description: Interface test-case verifier: run every test case in test_cases.json against a real HTTP service (calling the documented endpoints in order, getting a write token before each write step) and return the comma-joined IDs of the FAILING cases, in test_cases order. Generic - the base URL, token endpoint/body/path, package-id header, the cases, their assertions and the endpoint catalogue are all read from the input files (test_cases.json / api_doc.md / auth_config.json), never hard-coded. The model only translates each case's natural-language description into structured HTTP steps; the pass/fail assertion (status + field presence + exact values) is done in code.

task_description.description: The question text, verbatim. Carries the task framing; the actual cases, endpoints and auth config are read from the declared input files.

doc_dir.description: Name (or path) of the directory holding test_cases.json, api_doc.md and auth_config.json. Relative names resolve against the question directory. Optional; inferred from the question's declared files when omitted.
